notes.title: JUN '21 Update - VO and Optimizations
notes.content:
In this update we have added all of the critical path Voiceover to the entire game as well as some narrative voiceover, and secondary VO. The VO adds a world of difference and I hope you enjoy it, whether you're returning to Kala to battle the Combine, synths and Sons again, or starting your first-ever Journey, we are sure you will love this update.

In addition to the VO we have added a massive overhaul to the project optimization slimming it down and cutting out many of the unused assets that had been hanging out and causing some unnecessary giga-bloat. The overall size is about half of what it was which also gives us some room for our last gameplay area - the Sons Frigate - and giving the game is final and formal ending. 

The Frigate will be added in the months to come as well as the remaining VO, tuning and cinematics.

Unfortunately you may run into an error running from steam, and may have to run the Honor.exe from your Steam\steamapps\common\ Folder. We will be fixing this in a coming update. Don't worry, your save games will be intact.

More to come. Thanks!

notes.title: MAR '21 Update: 1-Year Anniversary!
notes.content:
It is our 1-Year Anniversary - to celebrate we are offering HONOR at 50% off for the next month.

This time last year the world was shutdown - nobody could fathom what was to come. It was incredibly strange to be developing a game that was based on a interstellar virus in which the Acquiry, our version of the (intergalactic) internet - is intentionally shut off - blinding countless billions of an impending invasion and cutting off all communication.

Last April we released into Early Access ahead of schedule. Since release we have updated hundreds of fixes, items, improvements ranging from waypoints to save points and an entirely new, massive open-world to explore. 

Our intention moving forward is to continue to polish the experience from animation, cinematics/story, audio and the moment to moment gameplay. 

In this update we have a number of behind-the-scenes fixes, MSK STAT tuning and the removal of many larger assets that were causing some performance issues. 

Thanks for your support.

notes.title: FEB '21 Update
notes.content:
In this update we have the first of several MSK Stat adjustments, a new default AOE Blast attack, several Quality of Life improvements and numerous bug fixes.

In addition, we will be laying out the update plans for '21 

[h1]IN THIS UPDATE[/h1]

MSK Stats 
-Mobility Stat now increases the corruption/overheat rate, meaning JUNA will be faster and dodge (doge?) more easily but their stamina will be reduced. The rate will improve as your MOV stat increases.

This is the reverse of how it worked before, where the KP stat increased the overheat rate. This will continue to be tuned as we tweak the different stat bonuses.

-Max Energy Capacity will also be increased by 100 per MOV Stat point.
-Max Energy will be reduced by 100 per SUR Stat point.

The New BLAST attack (defaults to C-key in Key Input) is an AOE Blast that will increase in damage and range per KP Point. The blast is super effective against swarms of smaller targets and deadly to all enemies at higher levels.

[h1]BUGS / QoL[/h1]

-Fixed and issue with the Blip controls.
-Additional Power Core throughout the levels.
-Add 'Saving' Text at all Local Relays.

[h1]'21 and Beyond[/h1]

We plan to continue to tune the MSK Stats to create more diverse options and support different playstyles. These tweaks will be added each update throughout the year. If you love something/or hate something, let us know!

Cinematics
Cine sequences are massive undertakings and they were shelved early on to focus on gameplay - we will be adding in new cinematic sequences to help convey more of the ultra-deep universe that CoH is set in. 

If you are a fan of lore, or want to read more about the CoH world(s) in general, check out the [url=https://www.thonthegame.com/uploads/1/3/3/1/13313531/th_wf_s.pdf]Tabletop Game Rulebook[/url], our prequel novel '[url=https://www.thonthegame.com/store/c6/Dice%2C__Books%2C_Digital_Products.html]sparks[/url]' available for print or free ebook, or our collection of short stories, [url=https://www.thonthegame.com/store/c6/Dice%2C__Books%2C_Digital_Products.html]Terminus[/url]. or get them on Amazon, [url=https://www.amazon.com/Thon-sparks-Tom-Rolland/dp/1976503108]here [/url]and [url=https://www.amazon.com/Thon-Terminus-Knowledge-Recovered-Warfront/dp/1976260981/ref=sr_1_1?dchild=1&keywords=jr+vosovic&qid=1614815856&sr=8-1]here[/url].


Thanks for your continued support!

-J.R. 
Forge Father Games

notes.title: NOV Update, STEAM Sale
notes.content:
[h1]IN THIS UPDATE[/h1]

New World - Irium!
New Items - Hundreds of new items added.
New Mech - The RETCH Remote Unit 
Traps!
Bug fixes

[h1]IRIUM[/h1]
This update is a big one with the new world - Irium. Irium is accessible from Doxer in the Ruins Spire - and players can toggle the map at any time to instantly teleport to/from any activated relay on either world.

Irium is a massive lush jungle world with dense forests, natural and unnatural inhabitants, ancient Highborn ruins teasing some of the planets storied history. As the Combine descends on Irium - its native Militia needs support - ally with The Climate House and Relay Management (CHARM) AI system on Irium to push back the Combine and protect the Militia. - what mysteries await? 

[h1]DETAILED SUMMARY[/h1]

Traps
Stun (M), Snare (S) and Proximity Mine (KP)

Each MSK Stat has its own trap which improves its effectiveness based on your character's numeric value.
All traps are activated when dropped (Right Click) from the inventory.
The Snare and Stun can be retrieved.

The Stun will stun enemies in range for (M-Stat) seconds.
The Snare will tangle enemies in range for (S) seconds and damage enemies with a DoT. Tangled enemies can still shoot.
The Proximity Mine will detonate damaging all enemies in range with a KP Damage Multiplier.

All traps can be purchased from their Respective Stores/Flash Production Drive - (FPD)

Broton 'Gunner' Set 
-Broton Gunner Set stats increased.
-Added Broton Gunner Blade.
-Broton Gunner Railgun vambrace now fires explosive Rail rounds with a medium blast radius.

Added Spirit Keeper Item Set
-Jet boots
-Holo Field
-Staff
-Helmet (Armet)

Radial Cooldown added to Encrypt Mech/vehicles (Virtuous, Retch, Vindicator)
Loot array improvements and more items.

[h1]THINGS TO COME[/h1]

MSK Tuned
We will be tuning the three primary stats and bonuses to better represent each, as well as their drawbacks.
Performance and optimizations
Enemy AI  improvements
Animation improvements
Story NPC Dialogue


Hope you are enjoying the game and as always, please post any issues or feedback, and happy holidays. -more updates to come.

notes.title: September Update
notes.content:
[h1]Save/Load - Perma-Death[/h1]
We have made a huge change to our save/load and we think this will bring a much needed reprieve to you. With the current change, when JUNA dies, she will instead be loaded back to the last checkpoint or activated relay instead of having to start over.

As the game has expanded from a shorter experience into a 10-14+ hr game - we realize it just isn't realistic to have to play through flawlessly and it is also a huge bummer to start over - given also the fact that we intend to regularly add new content, new worlds and expand the game, its a far better experience being able to die and try again with a minimal set back.

September was heavily focused on the new planet - Irigar and is almost complete. We are shooting to have this released and playable for the Holidays.
Irigar will be accessible at around 1/3 of the game, by talking to Doxer atop the Spire in the Ruins. Players will be able to switch back and forth between the two worlds any time from the map.

[h1]NEW MECH[/h1]
2nd Pilotable Mech will be the first Mech the player can pilot/possess - the Remote Combine Harbinger - RETCH is available on Irigar. It is a hefty biped equipped with railguns, cannon, grenade launcher and melee weapon.

-Additional Char Ingot cylinders in Hub. Acts as ammunition and currency.
-50% reduction in fall damage.
-Fixed an issue where the Ruins Rector would respawn after defeating it.
-Improved visibility of crit path in Solace. 
-Fixed some issues where the player could shoot/attack when Inventory open.
-Reduced Damage Value of ADU.
-Added ammo icon (Synth) to the Hunter's Magnum. 
-Fixed an issue where Tier 2 Atera drones would attack friendlies.
-Added FPD 'Store' to NPC 'Slim.'
-Pathing and Cover improvements in Relay Ruins.
-Increased MK2 Movement speed.

More to come, thanks!

notes.title: Post-Launch Roadmap
notes.content:
Hi, we are just 1-week away from launch.

I want to be as transparent as possible in the coming months and be available to you to answer questions, fix issues and make this game an amazing and unique experience. 

We will be releasing weekly updates to address critical issues. Our plan currently for the first two weeks is as follows:

[h1]PATCH 1 WEEK 1[/h1]
Address critical issues from community.

Example(s):
-Game wont start, launcher issues.
-Textures are muddy ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/42822/]be sure you have the latest steam installer. 64bit[/url])

NOTE: We have seen some issues during external testing where the textures were low-res and muddy on 32bit systems. Our internal version is 64bit, and running a 32bit version showed the low res materials. Be sure you are using the updated Steam - your computer does not need to be 64bit, just Steam - As far as I know - we are anticipating this being an issue and will fix is as soon as we have some additional test cases - Thanks for you patience! 

-settings bugs, resolutions, sensitivity etc.
-Critical Bug fixes

[h1]PATCH 2 WEEK 2[/h1]
Address critical issues from community.
-Game wont start
-Textures are muddy
-settings, etc.
-Critical Bug fixes

[h1]PATCH 3 WEEK 3 and BEYOND[/h1]
After our first two-weeks of critical fixes we will begin adding new content, fixing bugs and incorporating gameplay-related feedback. 

-Animation for main character
-Animation for enemies
-Animation for Vindicator (Mech Mode)
-AI and Enemies tuned

much, much more to come! 

Thanks for following, feedback and patience!
